versions.changelog: v1.0.6: Version bump only. No content changes. Bump 'Recently updated' sort.
Rewrite description with moment-of-need triggers; add Quick Reference table for agent evaluation scenarios
Add skill-card.md for ClawHub card verification.

Initial release of the claw-rl-prm-judge skill.

- Provides a Six-Dimension Process Reward Model (PRM) for evaluating AI agent turns.
- Scores each turn on intent alignment, reasoning quality, tool appropriateness, safety compliance, efficiency, and user value.
- Outputs structured JSON results for each dimension and a composite reward score.
- Includes calibration guidelines, usage instructions, and detailed reference files.
- Designed for integration with RL training, agent self-review, and policy optimization workflows.
